title: DNA Tension Probes to Map the Transient Piconewton Receptor Forces by Immune Cells
protocol: Dissolve the ligand strand DNA in water with 18.2 MΩ resistivity.
Vortex the solution.
Spin down the solution using a tabletop centrifuge.
Tune the volume of water to achieve a final concentration of 1 mM.
Measure the absorbance at 260 nm using a nanodrop spectrophotometer.
Determine the final concentration based on the extinction coefficient of the oligonucleotide.
Prepare 10x PBS and 1 M NaHCO3 solutions.
Mix 10 µL of the 1 mM amine ligand strand solution (10 nmol) with 10 µL of 10x PBS, 10 µL of 1 M NaHCO3, and 60 µL of H2O.
Dissolve 50 µg of Cy3B NHS ester in 10 µL of DMSO immediately before use.
Add the dissolved Cy3B NHS ester to the mixture for a total reaction volume of 100 µL.
Allow the mixture to react at room temperature for 1 h or overnight at 4 °C.
Conjugate the amine locking strand with Atto647N NHS ester.
Prepare a 10x PBS solution.
Prepare a 1 M NaHCO3 solution.
Mix 10 µL of the 1 mM amine locking strand solution, 10 µL of 10x PBS, and 10 µL of 1 M NaHCO3.
Add 60 µL of H2O to the mixture.
Dissolve 50 µg of Atto647N NHS ester in 10 µL of DMSO immediately before use.
Add the dissolved Atto647N NHS ester to the mixture for a total reaction volume of 100 µL.
Allow the mixture to react at room temperature for 1 h or at 4 °C overnight.
Remove by-products, excess dye, and salts from the reaction mixture using P2 desalting gel filtration.
Dilute the reaction mixture with H2O to a total volume of 300 µL.
Add 650 µL of hydrated P2 gel to a centrifugal device and spin down at 18,000 x g for 1 min.
Remove the liquid at the bottom of the device.
Add the reaction mixture to the column containing P2 gel.
Spin down at 18,000 x g for 1 min.
Collect the reaction mixture at the bottom of the device.
Hydrate P2 gel at least 4 hours before use with water.

Purify the desalted reaction mixture with HPLC using a C18 column for oligonucleotide purification, with solvent A: 0.1 M TEAA in H2O and B: ACN as mobile phases for linear gradient elution from 10-100% B over 50 minutes at a flow rate of 0.5 mL/min.
Inject the desalted reaction mixture in reverse-phase HPLC with a 500 μL injection loop for purification.
Collect product peaks based on absorbance at 260 nm and fluorophore-specific wavelengths (560 nm for Cy3B, 647 nm for Atto647N).
Dry collected products overnight in a vacuum centrifugal concentrator.
Reconstitute dried oligo-dye product in 100 μL water.
Determine concentration of the Cy3B ligand strand and Atto647N locking strand with nanodrop spectrophotometer, correcting for dye absorbance at 260 nm if necessary.
Validate purified product with MALDI-TOF-MS using 3-HPA as substrate in 50% ACN/H2O with 0.1% TFA and 5 mg/mL ammonium citrate, preparing samples at 1-5 μM for analysis.
Dissolve hairpin strand and quencher anchor strand in water to achieve stock solutions between 50 and 100 µM concentration.
Place the 25 mm coverslips on a polytetrafluoroethylene rack in a 50 mL beaker.
Rinse the coverslips by submerging in water three times.
Add 40 mL of a 1:1 ratio (v:v) solution of ethanol mixed with water to the beaker containing the rack and coverslips, and seal the beaker using a paraffin film.
Sonicate the beaker for 15 min in an ultrasonics cleaner (operating frequency 35 KHz).
Discard the liquid and rinse the beaker with the rack and coverslips in it with water at least 6 times to remove any remaining organic solvent.
Prepare fresh Piranha solution by mixing 30 mL of sulfuric acid with 10 mL of hydrogen peroxide in a clean 50 mL beaker.
Gently mix the Piranha solution using the end of a glass pipette.
Transfer the rack holding coverslips into the Piranha solution for etching.
Allow the coverslips to hydroxylate and clean for 30 minutes at room temperature.
After etching, transfer the rack with steel or polytetrafluoroethylene tweezers to a beaker of water.
Rinse the coverslips with water at least six times.
Immerse the rack holding the coverslips in a 50 mL beaker containing 40 mL ethanol to remove water.
Discard the ethanol and repeat the process three more times to ensure all water is removed.
Immerse the rack in 3% aminopropyl triethoxy silane (APTES) in 40 mL of ethanol for 1 hour at room temperature.
Rinse surfaces six times by submerging them into 40 mL ethanol.
Dry the surfaces in an oven at 80 °C for 20 minutes.
Store the dried amine-modified coverslips at -20 °C for future use (up to 6 months).
Cover the bottom inner side of a 10 cm diameter plastic Petri dish with paraffin film.
Place cooled-down amine-modified coverslips in the Petri dishes, ensuring the side to be functionalized faces up.
Weigh 1.5 mg of lipoic acid PEG NHS (LA-PEG-SC) and 7.5 mg of mPEG NHS (mPEG-SC) for each 25 mm coverslip.
Dissolve the NHS reagents immediately before use, as they have a short half-life (~10 min).
Add 300 μL of the dissolved LA-PEG-SC and mPEG-SC mixture to each coverslip and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Rinse surfaces three times with water after the reaction.
Perform NHS reaction at 4 °C overnight.
Add 100 μL of 0.1 M NaHCO3 containing 1 mg/mL sulfo-NHS acetate to "sandwich" coverslips.
Allow passivation for at least 30 min.
Rinse coverslips with water three times after passivation.
Incubate coverslips with 0.5 mL of gold nanoparticles (AuNP, 8.8 nm, tannic acid, 0.05 mg/mL) for 30 min at room temperature.
Pre-hybridize 4.7 pN hairpin, Cy3B ligand strand, and BHQ2 anchor strand in 1 M NaCl at 300 nM in a PCR tube.
Heat the solution to 95 °C for 5 min.
Gradually cool down the solution to 20 °C over 30 min.
Rinse coverslips with water three times.
Add additional BHQ2 anchor strand to the annealed DNA solution to achieve a 10:1 ratio between BHQ2 anchor strand and Cy3B ligand strand.
Add 100 µL of the DNA solution per two coverslips to create the "sandwich".
Place a wet lab tissue ball in the Petri dish away from the coverslips.
Seal the Petri dish with paraffin film.
Cover the Petri dish with foil and incubate at 4 °C overnight.
Wash excess probes from the coverslips with 1x PBS.
Check DNA tension probe surface quality under an epifluorescent microscope.
Prepare 40 µg/mL streptavidin in 1x PBS.
Incubate the prepared streptavidin on coverslips for 30 min at room temperature.
Rinse coverslips with PBS three times after incubation to wash away excess streptavidin.
Prepare 40 µg/mL biotinylated antibody/ligand in 1x PBS.
Incubate the prepared biotinylated antibody/ligand on the "sandwich" for 30 min at room temperature.
Rinse coverslips with PBS three times after incubation to wash away excess biotinylated antibody/ligand.
Assemble the clean imaging chambers with surfaces carefully.
Add 0.5-1 mL of Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS) to the imaging chambers.
Keep the chambers ready for imaging with cells.
Prepare immune cells of interest in HBSS at 1-2 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Purify OT-1 CD8+ naïve T cells from the spleens of sacrificed mice using the MACS mouse CD8+ T cell isolation kit.
Isolate and enrich the CD8+ T cells by removing any non CD8+ T cells that magnetic depleting antibody cocktail bound to.
Resuspend purified OT-1 CD8+ naïve T cells in HBSS at 2 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Keep the resuspended cells on ice prior to use.
Check the quality of DNA hairpin tension probe surface under a fluorescence microscope (100x objective) for quality control.
Image and quantify the average background intensity in Cy3B channel from at least 5 different positions and 3 replicates.
Plate approximately 4 x 10^4 to 10 x 10^4 cells onto each DNA tension probe functionalized coverslip.
Allow cells to attach and spread for about 15 minutes at room temperature.
Image fluorescence signals generated in the Cy3B channel as cells start to spread on the DNA hairpin tension probes.
Acquire images in both Cy3B and Atto647N channels after cells produce real-time tension signal on the surface.
Add Atto647N strand to the imaging chambers at a final concentration of 200 nM for mechanically selective hybridization.
Incubate the sample for 10 minutes.
Remove the buffer containing the fluorescent Atto647N locking strand quickly and gently.
Replace with fresh Hank's balanced salts.
Image the sample in both Cy3B and Atto647N channels.
Determine the Pearson's correlation coefficient using Fiji software.
Prepare a locking strand stock at 100 µM concentration.
Add the locking strand to cells at a final concentration of 1 µM.
Gently pipette to mix.
Incubate for 10 minutes to store tension signals.
Acquire time-lapse movies or end-point images in epifluorescence.
Initiate erasing of stored tension signals by adding an unlocking strand at 2 µM concentration if measuring tension at multiple time points is desired.
Incubate the sample with the unlocking strand for 3 minutes to erase stored signals.
Gently rinse excess oligonucleotides off with HBSS.
Perform image analysis using Fiji software.
Correct drift during image acquisition with the Correct 3D Drift command in Registration under the Plugins menu.
Remove the camera background of the image with the Subtract command under the Process menu.
Determine the Pearson's correlation coefficient with the Colocalization function under Analyze menu.
Average and subtract the fluorescence background produced by unopened probes from three different local background regions.
Draw ROIs of cells on either background-subtracted images or RICM images using Image J Freehand Selections tool.
Measure any metric of interest, such as integrated fluorescence intensity and tension occupancy, with the Measure tool under Analyze menu.
Export the measurements for quantitative analysis with an analysis software.
Plot the data with an analysis software.
